_comment: U.S. Treasury daily par yield curve, keyless, one CSV per calendar year.
Format checked 2026-09-24: header Date,"1 Mo","1.5 Month","2 Mo","3 Mo",
dates MM/DD/YYYY, newest first. Earlier years have fewer columns, so the
parser matches headers by name. The daily par curve begins in 1990.
_fred_note: Fallback only. FRED republishes Treasury's constant-maturity yields;
it is a redistributor, not the primary record, so rows it supplies carry
source=fred. Treasury's par curve and FRED's constant-maturity series are the
same Treasury calculation for these tenors.
